name: Matrix-matrix multiplication
text: Given matrices $A$ and $B$, we form their product $AB$ by first writing $B$ in terms of its columns $$ B = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} \vvec_1 \amp \vvec_2 \amp \cdots \amp \vvec_p \end{array}\right] $$ and then defining $$ AB = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} A\vvec_1 \amp A\vvec_2 \amp \cdots \amp A\vvec_p \end{array}\right]. $$
